response.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) AS avg_of_team_avgs FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g >= 53 GROUP BY team_id) AS t;

assumptions.assumption: A team is identified by team_id, so each team's average pools all of its qualifying manager_half rows across every year, half and manager, and each team counts once in the final average.
l is cast to REAL before dividing so SQLite does not use integer division. Rows with NULL l or g are ignored by AVG, and the g >= 53 filter already excludes NULL g.
